svg.title: Document intelligence: four coexisting research directions, 2007–2026
svg.desc: 62 representative models and methods on branching OCR/layout, document understanding, structured reasoning and document retrieval streams. Dates are first public paper years. Pale yellow highlights mark verified official weights. Branches organize research directions and do not imply model ancestry.
svg.text: Coexisting research directions; branches do not imply ancestry.
† Component / adapter weights · Years grouped, not linearly spaced
